mcp/http.ts
The Http module provides the HTTP server entry point used to expose the system over a web interface, invoked from the Firebase and serve startup paths.
mcp/tools/get-component-docs.ts
A server-side function module that assembles and returns documentation for a design system component for consumption by MCP tooling.
mcp/tools/get-component-stories.ts
A small script module that exposes a single function to retrieve component stories, used by the build and check tooling as it reaches shared code at run time.
mcp/tools/get-component.ts
A thin wrapper module exposing a getComponent function that retrieves component data from shared runtime resources.
mcp/tools/get-patterns.ts
Provides a get-patterns function that exposes pattern data from the shared module, likely backing an MCP tool for querying design patterns.
mcp/tools/get-rules.ts
Provides the MCP tool handler that returns design system rules shared from the project for an agent to consult.
mcp/tools/get-template-stops.ts
This module defines a single function that retrieves the list of named stop points used by a page template, serving the template rendering and validation scripts.
mcp/tools/get-template.ts
Provides a single accessor function for retrieving the shared page template used to assemble a finished piece.
mcp/tools/get-tokens.ts
This module exposes a getTokens function that retrieves the design token data from the shared layer for consumers elsewhere in the system.
mcp/tools/list-components.ts
Provides a single MCP tool handler that lists available design system components by delegating to shared logic.
mcp/tools/shared.ts
A small shared utility module defining the common tool-definition shape used by MCP tools and a helper for matching components, used across much of the server codebase.
scripts/build-mcp-firebase.ts
A Firebase-targeted build script for the MCP server, responsible for producing the deployable artifact that serves the design system's MCP tools over Firebase hosting.
scripts/build-mcp-metadata.ts
This module builds the MCP metadata, including the component/pattern/token catalog and the associated image catalog, used by the MCP server's tools.
scripts/build-pieces.mjs
A build script that assembles a talk piece's runtime artifacts and manifest from the design system's components.
scripts/check-islands.mjs
Check-islands.mjs is a validation script that checks island hydration correctness within the design system's rendered output, currently failing most of its checks.
scripts/check-pieces.mjs
A command line check script that renders or inspects pieces to validate the dom they produce, serving as the harness-invoked entry point for piece structural checks.
scripts/check-primitives.mjs
A command line script that validates primitive-level design system components.
scripts/check-runtime.mjs
Check-runtime is a validation script with an embedded server that verifies runtime page-serving behavior, such as path-based routing requirements, stays correct as the design system evolves.
scripts/lib/pieces-harness.mjs
Pieces-harness is a test harness module providing utilities to open, load, and inspect rendered pieces for use by validation check scripts like check-islands and check-pieces.
scripts/lib/preact-alias.mjs
A small module providing a Preact aliasing utility, exporting one operation, with no recorded requirements or incoming calls visible to the call graph.
scripts/lib/tag-contract.mjs

Tag-contract defines and validates the per-component tag contract used to determine ownership, node classification, descriptions, and prop listings for design system components, raising an error when a module lacks a contract.
scripts/render/cli.mjs
This module is the command-line entry point for rendering a talk piece, providing usage help, contract printing, tag listing, and version output.
scripts/render/core.mjs

Core defines the rendering engine that parses talk content and walks/encodes components into the HTML and props used to render a piece, including the error-raising checks that validate talk structure.
scripts/render/index.mjs
Entry module that renders a talk piece by coordinating core and spelling functionality, requiring a pieces folder to be present.
scripts/render/parse.mjs
Parse is the module that reads and decodes raw piece content into structured node data consumed across the markup, talk-preparation, node-resolution, and spelling-check pipelines.
scripts/render/spelling.mjs
Spelling is a module that checks the spelling of rendered talk content as part of the piece validation pipeline.
scripts/runtime/panel.mjs
The Panel module implements a runtime debugging overlay used during rendered-piece checks, invoked from the runtime boot process and relying on document.body being available.
scripts/runtime/runtime.mjs

Documents runtime.mjs as the core runtime module that renders components, hydrates islands, and coordinates with core and panel at run time, including a failure path where rejectPath can throw an Error.
src/App.tsx

The App module is the top level React entry component that wires together and renders the design system for preview, exporting a single App operation with no recorded internal call relationships or requirements yet.
src/charts/scale.ts
Provides scale construction logic used to map data values to visual coordinates for chart organisms like dumbbell, heatmap, line, and scatter charts.
src/components/atoms/Button/Button.tsx
Button is the atomic UI component providing the library's standard clickable button element.
src/components/atoms/ThemeToggle/LiveThemeToggle.tsx
The Live theme toggle module defines a single exported LiveThemeToggle component that provides a runtime control for switching the design system's theme while previewing or checking rendered pieces.
src/components/molecules/Carousel/Carousel.tsx
A carousel component that renders a scrollable, navigable track of items for presenting a sequence of content.
src/components/molecules/Dialog/Dialog.tsx
Dialog is a UI component module providing a modal dialog element gated on a non-null dialog state, exported for use elsewhere in the design system.
src/components/molecules/Field/Field.tsx
Field is a molecule component in the design system that renders a labeled form input wrapper, combining a label with its associated control element.
src/components/molecules/NavMobile/NavMobile.tsx
Renders the mobile navigation panel used by the site's responsive navigation UI.
src/components/organisms/BarSeries/BarSeries.tsx
BarSeries is a chart organism component that renders a bar series with animated reveal and formatted numeric labels.
src/components/organisms/Deck/Deck.tsx
The Deck module implements the Deck organism component that assembles and navigates between slides in a presentation, wiring up theme toggling and stop/mark navigation via useDeckNavigation.
src/components/organisms/Deck/useDeckNavigation.ts
A React hook that implements deck navigation, computing the active slide position and helper lookups like reduced, photoOf, box, and nameOf for a presentation deck.
src/components/organisms/Dumbbell/Dumbbell.tsx
Dumbbell is a chart component that renders a dumbbell-style data visualization, formatting and signing its values and reacting to reveal and numeric formatting state.
src/components/organisms/Heatmap/Heatmap.tsx
Heatmap is a chart organism component that renders a grid of color-coded values using a shared scale, number formatting, and reveal animation.
src/components/organisms/LineChart/LineChart.tsx

LineChart is a chart organism component that renders time-series or sequential numeric data as a line chart, deriving its own x and y scales, point selection, and data keys, and using tone, number formatting, and reveal-animation utilities to render and style the plotted lines.
src/components/organisms/LogoCarousel/LogoCarousel.tsx
Logo carousel module providing a React component that scrolls or cycles through a sequence of logo images as a visual element for a piece.
src/components/organisms/Marquee/Marquee.tsx
Marquee is a scrolling-content display component that assembles repeated pieces into a continuous looping band and rounds related values for layout.
src/components/organisms/Scatter/Scatter.tsx

A chart organism component that renders scattered data points, deriving position, size, naming, and selection from input data while applying scale, tone, number formatting, and reveal-animation behavior.
src/components/organisms/Sheet/Sheet.tsx

Sheet is a slide-like container component that composes a piece's visual content and relies on StepsContext at runtime, with an internal requirement that it only functions when a step-progression value is non-null.
src/components/organisms/Spotlight/Spotlight.tsx
Spotlight is a small UI component that conditionally renders a highlighting effect around a target element identified by an el reference.
src/components/organisms/Steps/Steps.tsx

Steps is a React component module that renders a sequenced list of numbered or linked steps, coordinating its child Step sub-components through shared context and requiring each step with a destination to have a valid target.
src/components/organisms/Tools/Tools.tsx
Tools is an MCP server module exposing a single exported operation as part of the set of agent-callable queries for the design system.
src/foundations/useTokenValue.ts
The useTokenValue module is a shared React hook that resolves a design token into its concrete rendered value for consumption by foundation display components.
src/hooks/useCenterState.ts
A React hook that determines a timeline entry's temporal state relative to a scroll or center reference point.
src/render.setup.ts
The Render module provides the app's render setup entry point used to initialize rendering for the library.
src/runtime/client.ts
The client module hydrates island components in the browser, using a marker on DOM elements to avoid re-hydrating them and relying on React to render content into slots.
src/runtime/islands.ts
Islands defines the client/server-shared registry and encoding logic that lets interactive components be rendered server-side and selectively revived as hydrated islands in the browser.
src/runtime/server.ts
Server-side rendering entry point that renders island components into HTML with their slot content, exposing a public operation for the runtime to generate server-rendered output.
src/templates/TalkTemplate/TalkTemplate.tsx

TalkTemplate is a full-page layout component that arranges a talk piece's slides and steps into a finished themed presentation, consuming StepsContext for navigation state and accepting a default theme via its props.
